evals.prompt: Validate tests/fixtures/invalid-crate and tell me what to fix.
evals.expected_output: Reports missing description, datePublished and licence and the missing file, with fixes.
expectations: Reports root lacks description, license and datePublished
Gives fixes as add/replace/remove with concrete values or asks for them

evals.prompt: I have no internet. Is tests/fixtures/minimal-crate OK?
evals.expected_output: Uses the offline lint script; says what it did not check.
expectations: States that profile/SHACL checks were not run

evals.prompt: I want rocrate-validator to also check our own profile: the root must have at least one author who is a Person. How do I set that up without forking the validator?
evals.expected_output: Profile folder <token>/<version>/profile.ttl (prof:hasToken, prof:isProfileOf 1.3, prof:isTransitiveProfileOf 1.3 and 1.2) + SHACL shape targeting the validator's RootDataEntity class with sh:path schema:author, sh:minCount 1, sh:class schema:Person; run with --extra-profiles-path and -p.
expectations: Uses --extra-profiles-path with a folder <token>/<version>/ holding profile.ttl and a SHACL .ttl file
profile.ttl declares prof:hasToken and prof:isProfileOf the RO-Crate version
Targets the root through the validator's RootDataEntity class (or the descriptor's about), not sh:targetClass schema:Dataset
The shape uses sh:path schema:author with sh:minCount 1 and sh:class schema:Person
Mentions MASP rules / ro-crate-masp as an alternative or source if the profile also has a Profile Crate
